title: ONE Residential Complex
description: ONE residential complex (ONE Development) is a business-class building in the quiet Inasaridze Street area in central Batumi: a blend of a calm residential quarter and the energy of the new city centre. Address reference: 29A Tbeli Abuseridze St.; about 700 m to the sea. Nearby — schools and kindergartens, Grand Mall and Black Sea Mall, Carrefour hypermarket, fitness and salons, fresh produce shops, cafés, Heroes Alley, Adjarabet Arena stadium, beach and promenade. The project is a renovation under the municipal programme "Batumi without hazardous buildings"; construction financed by TBC, mortgages up to 10 years available (confirm terms with the bank). European Property Awards 2025–2026 (Georgia). Completion — Q4 2027. Developer materials cite indicative long-term rental yields and value growth — not guaranteed; details from sales and onedev.ge.
